overview_description.description:
Buzzle is an online platform that delivers articles and categorized information for its users covering everything from sports to technology, literature, life sciences, cooking, fashion, banking, fitness, movies, philosophy, and spiritualism. It caters to people of diverse age groups and varied interests. The platform consists of 18 categories and over 5000 topics that encompass almost everything around the globe.

Buzzle was launched in 2000 and is based in Costa Mesa, C.A.
